studied_formula_assessment.studied_population: Adults with self-reported bloating, gas or abdominal discomfort; not pregnancy, pediatric or disease-treatment evidence.
studied_formula_assessment.limitations: Evidence is for the whole 24-strain plus pomegranate formulation, not individual strains, skin, heart health or micronutrient synthesis. 350 is the baseline sample of the symptom trial, not a sum across studies. No CFU conversion is known or used. PMID 40944126 and 41750436 share protocol NCT04171466; both report 32 randomized, with 27 and 21 completing respectively. The registration reports 46 actual participants across four arms; unique cohort overlap is unresolved, so counts are not summed. Their microbiome/metabolite and barrier outcomes are not independent symptom replication or demonstrated prevention of antibiotic-associated diarrhea. Trial reports establish the named formula, strain list and total potency, not the commercial label's per-blend or individual-strain quantities. Commercial per-blend allocations remain label-identity constraints only.
studied_formula_assessment.delivery_basis: Exact named product with complete matching composition; ViaCap documented in trial and manufacturer product reference, not inferred from capsule form alone.
